painlessBirth.question: Can childbirth be performed painlessly?
painlessBirth.answer: Yes, utilizing advanced modern medical techniques and tailored regional anesthesia protocols (such as Epidural analgesia and Patient-Controlled Analgesia PCA), labor and cesarean pain can be minimized significantly, ensuring a peaceful, safe, and empowering birth experience.

fibroids.question: Can uterine fibroids be treated without a hysterectomy?
fibroids.answer: With advanced minimally invasive laparoscopic techniques and Prof. Mohammed Mamdouh Saleh's specialized expertise, uterine fibroids can almost always be excised with extreme precision while completely preserving the uterus and the patient's future fertility.

laparoscopy.question: What are the advantages of advanced gynecological laparoscopy and laparoscopic hysterectomy?
laparoscopy.answer: Advanced gynecological laparoscopy allows complex surgical procedures, including laparoscopic hysterectomy and fibroid removal, to be performed through millimeter-sized incisions with minimal discomfort and same-day discharge. Prof. Mohammed Mamdouh Saleh is certified by the European Society of Gynaecological Endoscopy (GESEA Level 2 MIGS).

hydration.title: Optimal Daily Hydration
hydration.body: Drink 2.5 to 3 liters of water daily to maintain amniotic volume and prevent urinary tract infections.

checkup.title: Routine Screening & Ultrasound
checkup.body: Regular pelvic scans and cervical pap smears detect asymptomatic hormonal shifts and cysts early.

nutrition.title: Targeted Nutrition & Folic Acid
nutrition.body: Prioritize iron and calcium-dense foods, and start folic acid at least 3 months prior to conception.

exercise.title: Safe Physical Conditioning
exercise.body: Consistent walking and guided pelvic floor exercises mitigate back pain and facilitate smooth delivery.

booking.q: How can I book an appointment or consultation?
booking.a: You can book directly via phone with either branch, message our reception on WhatsApp, or submit an online request. Our team confirms all slots within minutes.

laparoscopy.q: What advantages does advanced gynecological laparoscopy and laparoscopic hysterectomy offer?
laparoscopy.a: Advanced gynecological laparoscopy enables delicate and complex procedures, including laparoscopic hysterectomy and fibroid removal, to be performed through millimeter incisions with minimal pain, rapid healing, and same-day discharge under the care of Prof. Mohammed Mamdouh Saleh, certified in GESEA Level 2 MIGS.

specialties.q: Do you handle high-risk pregnancies and complex recurrent miscarriages?
specialties.a: Yes, our centers specialize in high-risk obstetrics, recurrent pregnancy loss diagnostics, and advanced fertility preservation, supported by state-of-the-art 4D ultrasound.

branches.q: Where are your clinics located and what are their working hours?
branches.a: We operate two primary clinics in New Cairo (Fifth Settlement: Al-Narges - Ozone Mall BG029) and Madinaty (Medical Center next to City Authority, Clinic 209). Both branches offer advance reservation to eliminate waiting times.
